name: LFO
description: This algorithm offers a number of flexible low frequency oscillators. The global 'Quality' parameter offers two options: 'Stepped' quality is extremely low CPU usage, and is appropriate for automating parameters of other algorithms (via mapping). 'Linear' quality should be selected if you plan to use the LFOs to output CVs to other modules. The LFOs can run freely, or be synced to external clocks or to MIDI clock. Various trigger modes allow free-running, triggered, or gated operation. When there is more than one LFO channel, channels 2-4 can be locked to the phase of LFO 1. This allows you to, for example, create a quadrature LFO. Use the 'Phase' parameter of LFOs 2-4 to set the phase relationship in degrees to LFO 1. Note that in this case, the 'Speed' and 'Multiplier' parameters of the phase-locked LFO have no effect.
use_cases: Automating parameters of other algorithms via mapping
gui_description: The display shows the shape of the current channel's output, or if the 'Globals' page is active, the shape of all the channels.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Sets the LFO output quality. The options are "Stepped" and "Linear".

parameters.name: Trigger mode
parameters.description: The trigger mode for the channel.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: Sets the LFO speed, from 0.05Hz to 15Hz with an exponential scaling.

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the LFO speed. The options are "x0.1", "x1", "x10", & "x100".

parameters.name: Sine
parameters.description: Sets the amplitude of a sine wave to add into the LFO output.

parameters.name: Triangle
parameters.description: Sets the amplitude of a triangle wave to add into the LFO output.

parameters.name: Saw
parameters.description: Sets the amplitude of a saw wave to add into the LFO output.

parameters.name: Square
parameters.description: Sets the amplitude of a square/pulse wave to add into the LFO output.

parameters.name: Pulse width
parameters.description: Sets the pulse width of the square/pulse wave.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Adds a constant voltage to the LFO output.

parameters.name: Asymmetry
parameters.description: Sets the asymmetry. This is somewhat like applying a pulse width variation to a square wave, but applies equally to all the waveforms.

parameters.name: Random
parameters.description: Adds a stepwise random voltage to the LFO output.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Selects how the LFO will sync to external clocks or MIDI.

parameters.name: Clock multiplier
parameters.description: Sets the clock multiplier, if syncing to external clocks.

parameters.name: MIDI divisor
parameters.description: Sets the MIDI clock divisor, if syncing to MIDI clock.

input_ports.name: Clock input
input_ports.description: The bus to use as the clock input.

input_ports.name: Reset input
input_ports.description: The bus to use as the reset input.
